name: Diamond Bracelet
effect: Can collect all of the enemy’s offensive artifacts and weapons · but ineffective against the Banana Fan
background: Forged by Taishang Laojun during his westward journey · refined from kun steel
battle_impact: Changes Heaven’s combat meta: single-artifact builds are obsolete · group tactics required
popularity: Once widespread, all demons relying on a single artifact lost their jobs

name: Golden-Hooped Rod
owner: Yu the Great → East Sea Dragon King → Sun Wukong
effect: Physical damage ×3 · can grow or shrink · weighs 13,500 jin
counter: None (but collected by the Diamond Bracelet)
background: The sea-calming needle from Yu the Great’s flood control · later kept in the East Sea Dragon Palace
battle_impact: The strongest single-target melee weapon · unbeatable at close range

name: Banana Fan (Yang)
effect: One fan blows 84,000 li · nothing can withstand it · special attack vs the Diamond Bracelet
background: A wisp of lunar leaf from behind Kunlun Mountain, born at the dawn of chaos
battle_impact: Core of the group-displacement build · can reshape the battlefield
popularity: Depends on the wielder’s power · low adoption

name: Purple Gold Gourd
owner: Taishang Laojun → Golden Horn & Silver Horn
effect: Answer to your name and turn to pus in a matter of hours
counter: A false name (e.g. 'Sun the Pilgrim' 'Pilgrim Sun')
background: Condensed from the golden qi emitted by the gourd during Laojun’s westward journey
battle_impact: Single-target sure kill · but requires knowing the true name
popularity: Circulates within Heaven · demons must steal to obtain it

name: Yin-Yang Bottle
effect: Sealed in the bottle · turns to slurry in hours · Wukong must use Guanyin’s three hairs to break free
background: Condensed from the dual qi of yin and yang · exclusive to the Golden-Winged Roc
battle_impact: Single-target sure kill · but effect halved against top-tier UR cards

name: Nine-Tooth Rake
effect: Physical damage ×1.5 · -50% damage vs female demons
background: Forged by Heaven’s divine hammer · originally Marshal Tianpeng’s tally of command
battle_impact: Stable output · but heavily affected by emotions

name: Demon-Subduing Staff
effect: Physical damage ×1.2 · stable output, no variation
background: Made from Wu Gang’s osmanthus tree · crafted by Lu Ban

name: Golden Hoop Mantra

counter: None (unless 100 li away from Tang Sanzang)

name: Fiery Golden Eyes
effect: Sees through all illusion and transformation · but sensitive to smoke

name: Three Life-Saving Hairs

battle_impact: A life-saving item · but with limited uses
